content:
**Crack Shot** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increasing range and accuracy from all small guns when sighted.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Small guns have 30% more range and 30% more accuracy when aiming down sights. | 0031D4B1 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Small guns have 20% more range and 20% more accuracy when aiming down sights. | 0031D4B0 | 
| ★ | 1 | Small guns have 10% more range and 10% more accuracy when aiming down sights. | 0031D4AF |
